programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Doc Nose Best: Patients this week include a difficult, quarter-ton boar with razor-sharp tusks and the victim of a near-fatal skunk attack. (S6, ep 12)

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Twist and Snout: This week brings a complicated calving in dangerous whiteout conditions and a Jack Russell with "swimmer puppy syndrome." (S6, ep 13)

programme.title: The Hummingbird Effect
programme.desc: Venture across Costa Rica to witness the country's dazzling diversity of hummingbirds and learn how these tiny creatures play a massive role in one of the wildest environments on Earth. 7+

programme.title: The Incredible Honey Badger
programme.desc: Through astonishing footage of real-life confrontations, we see how each brush with death refines the honey badger's fearlessness. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Wild Cats Of India
programme.desc: Big Cat Kingdom: Cameras track a snow leopard as it fights to keep its kill from an unrelenting red fox, and chart the lives of the last surviving Asiatic lions of Gir. (1 of 2) 7+

programme.title: Wild Cats Of India
programme.desc: Masters of Disguise: Cameras embark on a quest to uncover the secret lives of India's small cats, including the rare clouded leopard. (2 of 2) 7+

programme.title: Antoni Porowski: London
programme.desc: London: Antoni explores London, from Brick Lane flavours to a fresh take on the Sunday roast, plus rare access to Big Ben, hidden swims and The Shard. (S1, ep 1) 7+

programme.title: Antoni Porowski: Mexico City
programme.desc: Mexico City: Antoni Porowski explores Mexico City's flavours, culture and colour, from fine dining to lucha libre, uncovering what makes this city unmissable. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: New: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Waterway Babies: Australia's rivers, wetlands, lakes and floodplains provide the perfect nursery for an extraordinary collection of young wildlife. (S1, ep 4) 7+

programme.title: New: Critter Fixers: Country Vets
programme.desc: Quirky Companions: In rural Georgia, an influx of highly unusual pets requiring extraordinary veterinary care pass through the bustling hospital. (S5, ep 3)

programme.title: Rebuilding Notre Dame
programme.desc: The Next Chapter: Following the 2019 fire that almost destroyed Paris's iconic Notre Dame Cathedral, a team of experts set out to restore this historic landmark. (1 of 2) 7+

programme.title: Rebuilding Notre Dame
programme.desc: Final Chapter: Five years after the fire, get exclusive access to Notre Dame's one billion restoration, now entering its final stages. (2 of 2) 7+

programme.title: France From Above
programme.desc: France: A spectacular aerial journey across France reveals a cultural powerhouse set in a vast landscape of contrasts and surprises. 7+

programme.title: Wild Hunters
programme.desc: Bears: Get up close and personal with one of Earth's most extreme predators. As the seasons change, so do bears' bodies, allowing them to endure the very harshest of conditions. 7+ S1 ep 5

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick hosts an award ceremony in 'The Starry Awards', and then in 'Blorpsgiving', Captain Doug Quasar meets Pat-Tron's robot family. (S1, ep 23)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: GrandPat competes for Granny Tentacles' love on a dating game show in 'The Dated Game', then in 'Ice Cream Headache', The Ice Cream Man and Ice Cream King team up to capture an icy beast. (S4, ep 2)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: It's the annual foam-fisted all-camp karate battle in 'Hill Fu', then in 'Sun's Out, Fun's Out', It's the hottest day of summer, but there's only one AC in the whole camp. (S1, ep 15)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A secret snack experiment has monstrous side effects in 'Midnight Snack Attack', then in 'Hot Pearl-tato', Mr. Krabs needs to find a babysitter for Pearl, but she proves too much to handle. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Sandy gets a brand-new suit in 'The Suit Suits You', then in 'Parasite Pals', SpongeBob's newest friend is a hungry parasite inside of him. (S2, ep 12)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob tries to catch a Moon Jelly in 'Mooned!', then in 'Hysterical History', Sandy learns some Bikini Bottom history. (S14, ep 8)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Tinkle, Ouchie, and Pinkeye must venture back home together in 'The Uncredible Journey', then in 'Host-a-Palooza', Patrick gets injured, so his family members take turns hosting the show. (S1, ep 15)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: In an episode about boats, Cecil teaches Patrick how to drive in 'Driven to Drive', then in 'A Patty in Time', Patrick time-travels in a race for the Krusty Krab's newest menu item. (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: In 'Sleepy Time' SpongeBob visits the dreams of his friends and neighbours. While in 'Suds' SpongeBob comes down with an illness which turns him into a bubble maker. (S1, ep 15)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The Star Family heads to their favourite resort in 'Gas Station Vacation', then in 'Bunny the Barbarian', Bunny goes on a mid-day adventure to a forgotten age. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick learn a really bad word, and start using it everywhere (yipes!) in 'Sailor Mouth', and then in 'Artist Unknown', Squidward tries to teach SpongeBob about art. (S2, ep 18)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: The Sponge Who Could Fly (AKA The Lost Episode): Patchy discovers a brand new episode of SpongeBob - and then loses it. But he finds it again! Meanwhile, SpongeBob tries to fly.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: Patrick's injury recovery causes trouble for the camp in 'Five Times The Fun', then in 'Low Falutin', Rea and Roh learn to support themselves. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick are split up into separate cabins in 'Helter Shelter', then in 'Reveille Revolution', Squidward has to earn back his morning 'Reveille' duties. (S1, ep 20)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Plankton turns everyone into babies in 'Goo Goo Gas', and then in 'Le Big Switch', SpongeBob switches places with a snooty French chef at a high-end restaurant.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward invites a TV show to visit his not exactly camera-ready home in 'House Fancy', then in 'Krabby Road', SpongeBob thinks that Plankton is trying to start a band. Which gives Plankton an idea.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The Patricks compete for control of the TV remote in 'Pat-Tathlon', then in 'Upturn's Downturn', after driving over Patrick, a court order forces Lady Upturn to live with the Star family. (S4, ep 8)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: The Patrick Show gets competing sponsors in 'The Patrick Show Sells Out', then in 'Neptune's Ball', the Star family visits King Neptune's palace. (S1, ep 21)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.desc: Southampton: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. For Southampton, the nine-goal thriller with Man Utd that ended 6-3 to Saints.

programme.title: PL Greatest:Liverpool/Barnsley '97
programme.desc: Barnsley: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. Here, for Barnsley, the 1-0 win over Liverpool at Anfield in November 1997.

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Hedda, lured away by a message that her sister is ill, finds herself an unwilling pawn in Gessler's latest plot.

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Brian Smyth. Lt. Briggs breaks the treaty by chasing a Native American beyond the recognized border.

programme.title: The Lone Ranger
programme.desc: 1949. Stars Jay Silverheels, Clayton Moore & John Hart. The famous war horse Black Cloud is stolen along with Lame Bear's son. Lone Ranger needs to use all his diplomacy skills.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Greydon Gould. Despite warnings from locals, the Supercar team explore an underwater temple only to find out why they were warned.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Nigel Davenport & Peter Welch. With the outlaws desperately in need of money, Marian hatches a scheme involving her uncle and an archery tournament.

programme.title: Teenage Zombies
programme.desc: 1959. Horror. Directed by Jerry Warren. Stars Don Sullivan, Katherine Victor & Steve Conte. A group of teens become stranded on an island and are captured by a mad scientist with villainous plans.

programme.title: Busy Bodies
programme.desc: 1933. Comedy. Directed by Lloyd French. Stars Stan Laurel and Oliver Hardy. Stan & Ollie do battle with inanimate objects & their co-workers during a routine work day at the saw mill.

programme.title: The Woman in Green
programme.desc: 1945. Mystery. Director: Roy William Neill. Stars: Basil Rathbone and Henry Daniell. Sherlock Holmes investigates the mysterious murders of women, all of whom have their forefinger severed.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: The Hidden Face. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Pamela Abbott. When a member of parliament takes his own life, his son seeks the author of the book that triggered the tragedy. (S1, E.

programme.title: The Cruel Sea
programme.desc: 1953. War. Directed by Charles Frend. Stars Jack Hawkins, Donald Sinden & Denholm Elliott. The dramatic story of a British convoy escort ship and its novice crew who set out to save lives.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Kay Adshead. Swiftnick frees a gypsy girl from a trap then must prove to her tribe he has not shamed her by facing three ordeals chosen by fate.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Neville Jason. When expected to give evidence at a murder trial, Maigret gets a feeling that the accused may actually be innocent.

programme.title: Lillie
programme.desc: 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Derek Smith & Denis Lill. Lillie rejects the advances of King Leopold of Belgium and her friendship with Oscar Wilde intensifies.

programme.title: Bellman and True
programme.desc: 1987. Thriller. Directed by Richard Loncraine. Stars Bernard Jill, Derek Newark & Richard Hope. A computer expert is forced to use his scientific genius to pull off a daring bank heist.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, we solve the secret of the moving nipple, look into the mystery of wee willy winky, watch as Lolo makes a ham sandwich and see a man getting nibbled.

programme.title: Yanky Panky
programme.desc: Join country music persona Tina C as she uncovers the eccentric subcultures, bizarre personalities, and the rude, crude and lewd underbelly of American society.

programme.title: The Runaway Train
programme.desc: 1985. Action. Directed by Andrey Konchalovskiy. Stars Jon Voight, Eric Roberts & Rebecca De Mornay. Two escaped convicts and a railway worker find themselves trapped on an out of control train.

programme.title: A Saint, A Woman, A Devil
programme.desc: 1977. Drama. Director: Peter Savage. Stars Joanna Bell, Marc Stevens & Sonny Landham. Sylvia is a seemingly quiet and saintly person. But she is hiding a promiscuous multiple personality disorder.

programme.title: To The Four Corners

programme.title: One Step Beyond

programme.title: The Atomic Submarine
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-fi. Directed by Spencer Gordon Bennet. Stars Arthur Franz & Dick Foran. A submarine is sent out to investigate a series of naval disasters, but the crew also get caught up in the chaos.

programme.title: Dial 999

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Shoeless Engineer. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson encounter an injured man carrying an unconscious woman.

programme.title: Twist or Stick
programme.desc: It's a 1960s twisting compilation see 'The Hollies' Shane Fenton & The Fentones, The Orchids, The Keytones, a lot of 'That Old Yeah, Yeah Feeling' and much more.

programme.title: The Four Feathers

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer

programme.title: The Railway Children
programme.desc: 2000. Drama. Directed by Catherine Morshead. Stars Jenny Agutter & Richard Attenborough. Three children are forced to move to Yorkshire with their mother after their father is falsely imprisoned.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake, Clare Richards. Mrs. Price is lonely in London and wants to move in with the family, so they hatch a plan to put her off.

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Ada's convinced that the baby is overdue, and Walter gambles his months pension. (S4, E.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
